body.message:
I would like to express my serious dissatisfaction regarding the failure to register my vehicle for parking as required.

This issue is causing delays to my work, wasting my time, and exposing me to unnecessary parking charges and penalties that could have been avoided had the vehicle been properly registered.

This situation is unacceptable, and I request that the matter be addressed immediately and that the necessary measures be taken to ensure it does not happen again in the future.
